svg.title: Which Frame IDs the 11.5.0 validator accepts
svg.desc: The validator accepts five Frame ID ranges and values: 0xC000 to 0xF7FF, 0xF800 to 0xFBFF, 0xFEFD, 0xFEFE and 0xFEFF; those frames give an Internet layer named Profinet. Every other Frame ID is an UnknownFrameId reported in corrupted although the frame is healthy: RT_CLASS_3 and RT_CLASS_1 cyclic data, alarms, DCP Hello, PTCP, fragments. Issue 133 tracks it.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the accepted ranges, the DCP structure is applied to any frame:

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cyclic data made of 0x00 passes with meaningless DCP fields, data made of 0xFF fails as an invalid DCP block length.
